description:
Makes the 5G NR decode stage of `gf2-sim` decode through the generic batch decode stage with the rate-matched batch decoder.

## Background

The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. A `gf2-sim` stage processes a batch by shared reference with a default-constructed mutable scratch. The generic batch decode stage of `gf2-sim` holds a factory of a `gf2-coding` batch soft decoder, builds the decoder once in its scratch, and decodes an `LlrBatch` into a `HardDecisionBatch` with the per-frame iteration counts recorded in the scratch. `gf2-coding` has a rate-matched 5G NR implementer of the trait. The stage `Nr5gDecode` builds a rate-matched decoder from a clone of the shared code for each frame; its scratch records the per-frame iteration counts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Nr5gDecode` decodes its batch through the generic batch decode stage with the rate-matched batch decoder, and constructs no decoder per frame.
- [hard] REQ-02: The message bits of each frame and the recorded per-frame iteration counts equal those of the per-frame `decode_iterative` path.
- [hard] REQ-03: The preset and graph pipelines that contain the stage produce byte-identical outputs in the existing byte-identity suites.
title: Decode NR stage batches through the batch decode stage
